76:26.text: And during night, prostrate yourself to Him
(i.e. the offering of Maghrib and ‘Ishâ’ prayers)
, and glorify Him a long night through

76:27.text: love the present life of this world, and put behind them a heavy Day

76:28.text: It is We Who created them, and We have made them of strong built. And when We will, We can replace them with others like them with a complete replacement.

76:29.text: is an admonition, so whosoever wills, let him take a Path to his Lord

76:30.text: But you cannot will, unless Allâh wills. Verily, Allâh is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.

76:31.text: He will admit to His Mercy whom He wills and as for the Zâlimûn -
He has prepared a painful torment.

77:1.text: (or angels or the Messengers of Allâh)

77:2.text: And by the winds that blow violently.

77:3.text: And by the winds that scatter clouds and rain.

77:4.text: that separate the right from the wrong.

77:5.text: And by the angels that bring the revelations to the Messengers,

77:6.text: To cut off all excuses or to warn.

77:7.text: Surely, what you are promised must come to pass.

77:8.text: Then when the stars lose their lights.

77:9.text: And when the heaven is cleft asunder.

77:10.text: And when the mountains are blown away.

77:11.text: And when the Messengers are gathered to their time appointed.

77:12.text: For what Day are these signs postponed?

77:13.text: For the Day of Sorting Out
(the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell)

77:14.text: And what will explain to you what is the Day of Sorting Out?

77:15.text: Woe that Day to the deniers

77:16.text: Did We not destroy the ancients?

77:17.text: So shall We make later generations to follow them.

77:18.text: Thus do We deal with the Mujrimûn

77:19.text: Woe that Day to the deniers
